submission.justification: Radiator-R2 at 3.0625 cm is the best-performing simulated design, giving the highest recorded pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c: 4.883 sigma. However, the humidity-ageing transparency-loss hard requirement could not be verified for any candidate because no 10-year-equivalent transparency-loss values were available in the recorded results; therefore this is a performance-based recommendation only, not a fully compliant qualified selection until ageing data confirm ≤10% loss.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c.
requirements.evidence: Best recorded simulation result is Radiator-R2 at 3.0625 cm with separation 4.883 sigma; all R1 and R3 sampled/refined values are lower.

requirements.requirement: The radiator must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Radiator-R2 is one of the allowed candidates; recorded allowed_R2 = 1.

requirements.requirement: Transparency loss after a 10-year-equivalent humidity ageing test must not exceed 10%.
requirements.evidence: No transparency-loss value was available for R2, or for any candidate: transparency_loss_available_R1/R2/R3 = 0 and hard_requirement_verified_R1/R2/R3 = 0. Recorded compliant_candidates_count = 0 and no_compliant_selection_possible = 1.
Recommended thickness is 3.0625 cm, which lies within the allowed 1–6 cm range.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended radiator and thickness.
